title: UI/UXデザイン
subtitle: UI/UX Design
educationalGoal: In this class, students learn the basics of UI/UX design: making a concept, information structure, application design, and multimedia materials. Students create smartphone applications using Figma. In addition, students will learn about design rules based on cognitive psychology.
advice: In this class, students learn the basics of UI/UX design: making a concept, information structure, application design, and multimedia materials. Students create smartphone applications using Figma. In addition, students will learn about design rules based on cognitive psychology.
books: Figma for UIデザイン アプリ開発のためのデザイン、プロトタイプ、ハンドオフ(株式会社 翔泳社) 参考書:UIデザイン必携 ユーザーインターフェースの設計と改善を成功させるために(株式会社 翔泳社)
